aot.help: Extract + train the Leyden AOT cache dependably (#901): the web-jar chain first, then the training run.

aot-only.help: RAW step: extract the run layout + train the Leyden AOT cache against a throwaway Postgres (#257), WITHOUT dependency expansion; prefer `aot`.

build.help: Build the container images as a live split-pane pipeline (unit gates first, then web jar + sidecar/web/FRR/unmanaged images, VyOS on demand).

builder-image.help: Build the gradle builder image (netctl-builder:local) the web-jar step runs in; layer-cached, cheap to rerun.

compile-java.help: Compile the four Java modules (gradle classes testClasses) in the containerised toolchain, without running any tests.

compile-python.help: Byte-compile the sidecar, orchestrator and labgen Python sources (python -m compileall -q) in the host venv, without running any tests.

diff.help: Generate a Liquibase changelog from the orm.xml model (Docker).

docs.help: Render the project docs via docToolchain in Docker.

frr-image.help: Build the FRR lab node image (netctl-frr:local) (#901).

gradle.help: Run arbitrary gradle tasks in the containerised toolchain (the missing ./gradlew): persistent gradle + Vaadin caches and the Nexus mirror wiring applied for you.

iol-image.help: Build the router Cisco IOL lab node image (netctl-iol:17.18.02) from the pinned CML release asset; needs gh authenticated.

iol-l2-image.help: Build the L2-switch Cisco IOL lab node image (netctl-iol-l2:17.18.02) from the pinned CML release asset; needs gh authenticated.

radius-image.help: Build the FreeRADIUS lab node image (netctl-radius:local) (#1115).

reclaim-workspace.help: Reclaim workspace ownership after the root gradle containers (#498): chown the checkout back to you on native Linux; a no-op on macOS, where virtiofs already maps container-root writes to the host user.

sidecar-image.help: Build the sidecar image (netctl-sidecar:local); no prerequisites.

supplicant-image.help: Build the 802.1X supplicant lab client image (netctl-supplicant:local) (#1115).

unmanaged-image.help: Build the unmanaged LLDP-neighbour lab node image (netctl-unmanaged:local) (#1338).

verify-freshness.help: Verify the build left DEPLOYABLE artifacts (#424/#1047): the web bootJar and netctl:local exist, and both the jar and the app.jar inside the image say productionMode true.

vyos-image.help: Build the VyOS lab node image (netctl-vyos:local) when lab.yml requests a VyOS node; a no-op otherwise (the ISO fetch + ~2.8GB image is on-demand only).

web-image.help: Build the deployable web image dependably (#901): the full builder-image -> web-jar -> aot chain first, then the image build.

web-image-only.help: RAW step: docker build the deployable web image (netctl:local) from the extracted build/aot layout, WITHOUT dependency expansion; prefer `web-image`.

web-jar.help: Build the production web bootJar dependably (#901): builder-image first, then the gradle run.

web-jar-only.help: RAW step: the production web bootJar (gradle :web:bootJar -Pvaadin.productionMode) in the builder image, WITHOUT dependency expansion; prefer `web-jar`.

add-client.help: Deploy a client on a free l3s port and bind it to a service.

all.help: Full end-to-end bring-up + tests (build + up + seed + zabbix + accept) as ONE live-streamed plan.

backup.help: Dump every site catalog DB (pg_dump) into backup/ for DR (lab only).

bringup.help: Bring the lab up from a COLD host (install -> build -> up -> seed -> zabbix) as a live-streamed split-pane pipeline.

clean.help: Destroy the lab and remove build outputs, images, generated artifacts (`clean vm` also deletes the Colima VM).

down.help: Destroy the containerlab topology (--cleanup wipes the IOL NVRAM) and remove the OOB bridges.

openbao-pki.help: Provision the env's OpenBao PKI (NMS root + per-node issuing CAs + scoped tokens); idempotent (#171 E1a).

provision.help: Provision the overlay services against the running lab (no tests).

render.help: Render the lab artifacts (clab topology, device configs, seed scripts) from deploy/env/dev/lab.yml.

rescue.help: OOB rescue (#566): reassert a site sidecar's cached last-known-good SYSTEM config through the device backend over mgmt/OOB, with no consensus.

reset.help: Full from-scratch reset: clean + delete the Colima VM (= clean vm).

seed.help: Run the end-to-end bootstrap/smoke test: wait for every controller's REST API, then run the generated seed.sh.

up.help: Deploy the lab as a live split-pane TUI pipeline (up-preflight -> render -> up-deploy -> up-finish): LEFT the phases with their state, RIGHT the live output of the highlighted phase. Authoritative verdict last; NETCTL_STRICT_UP=1 fails on any degraded condition.

up-deploy.help: PHASE of `up`: the ATOMIC containerlab deploy (OOB bridges, amd64 binfmt + Rosetta watchdog, clab deploy with retry, verdict) plus the #1004 mgmt egress isolation.

up-finish.help: PHASE of `up`: IOS slot-1 recovery, Zabbix + OpenBao PKI provisioning, the controller-readiness gate, the portal, and the verdict over every phase's degraded conditions.

up-preflight.help: PHASE of `up`: the host preflight (docker/Colima, the disk/WireGuard/capability guards, image presence + provenance), the local-backend assertion, and the reset of the shared degraded file.

zabbix.help: Provision the Zabbix hosts (all nodes + SNMP devices) via the generated zabbix-provision.sh.

collect-logs.help: Dump every lab container's log, gzipped, into test/reports/logs (evidence for a failing run).

connect.help: Open an interactive session on a lab target: SSH to a managed device, or a shell in a container.

logs.help: Show a container's logs, or list the lab containers when no node is given.

status.help: Show the lab dashboard (container state + app/browser reachability).

package.help: Build registry-tagged images for the current arch.

publish.help: Push the packaged images to the registry (multi-arch when PUBLISH_PLATFORMS is set).

check.help: Verify tools, OS, and the cisco_iol image.

claude-plugins.help: Install the Claude Code plugins this repo is developed with, as declared in the manifest's `claude` section (#1286); idempotent, --dry-run previews.

completion.help: Regenerate the product's shell completion from its manifest (--check reports drift and writes nothing).

disk-guard.help: Prune docker dangling images + build cache when the data fs is low on space (NETCTL_DISK_GUARD=0 disables, NETCTL_DISK_MIN_FREE_PCT sets the bar).

doctor.help: Run read-only preflight checks in a split-pane TUI (docker, colima, egress, images, lab containers, topology).

environments.help: List the named environments (#15) and the backend each targets, marking the active one.

install.help: Install the host prerequisites (containerlab on Linux; Colima + docker + containerlab on macOS).

lab-sites.help: Print the sites straight from lab.yml: '<name> <http_port> <platform> <mon|-> <id>'.

nexus.help: Drive the LAN Sonatype Nexus artefact proxy (#948): up | down | status | repos | cleanup; bare lists the members.

auth-scopes.help: Grant the stored gh token the package scopes GHCR needs (interactive, idempotent).

prune-branches.help: Delete local branches already merged into main (squash-aware via gh).

submodules.help: git submodule update --init lib/platform (init the submodule a fresh worktree needs).

catalogue.help: List the task coordinates the delivery kernel offers, marking the namespaces this product's commands reach.

generate.help: Regenerate the product's CLI module from its manifest (--check reports drift and writes nothing).

accept.help: Convenience: run the lab-based suites in sequence (system + acceptance-dataplane + acceptance-ui + report) against the running lab; extra args pass through to the system pytest.

acceptance-dataplane.help: ACCEPTANCE-DATAPLANE gate: the test/acceptance/python black-box dataplane reachability suite against the running lab, APPENDING into the shared Allure results (#860).

acceptance-ui.help: ACCEPTANCE-UI gate: the Playwright frontend/e2e journeys against this instance's seeded lab controller, resolved not hardcoded (#680/#860/#706).

all.help: Run the COMPLETE e2e (#720): bring the lab up + seed, run every test stage, then the lab-based system + acceptance suites and the Allure report - no longer lab-free.

boot-java.help: BOOT-JAVA gate: the context-load smoke test that boots the full web Spring ApplicationContext (#288).

component-db.help: COMPONENT-DB gate: assert the real Liquibase changelog applies against a throwaway TimescaleDB (the Postgres-only Timescale changesets), a DB component test in its own lane (#253/#860).

component-java.help: COMPONENT-JAVA gate: the web view/controller component-logic tests in Docker (#234).

integration-java.help: INTEGRATION-JAVA gate: the infrastructure @DataJpaTest persistence slices (Spring + H2 + Liquibase) in Docker (#234).

lint-shell.help: LINT-SHELL gate (static analysis): shellcheck netctl.sh via Docker.

report.help: REPORT step: merge the Java unit results into the shared Allure results and render the single-file Allure HTML archive (#860).

system.help: SYSTEM gate: the test/system/python suite against the running lab, into the shared Allure results; it runs FIRST and clears them (#860). Trailing args reach pytest verbatim (`-k <expr>`) and quarantine that run into its own results dir (#1406).

typecheck-python.help: TYPECHECK-PYTHON gate: mypy over the sidecar, orchestrator and labgen sources in the host venv (fast, lab-free).

unit-java.help: UNIT-JAVA gate: domain + application + framework-free infrastructure tests plus spotless static analysis in Docker (fast, lab-free).

unit-java-core.help: UNIT-JAVA-CORE gate: spotless plus the three FRAMEWORK-FREE Java modules (domain, application, infrastructure) in Docker - the half of the unit gate that needs no Vaadin frontend.

unit-java-web.help: UNIT-JAVA-WEB gate, dependably (#1238): the production web jar first (its frontend is what :web:test needs), then the web module's unit tests.

unit-java-web-only.help: RAW step: the web module's unit tests (gradle :web:test) in the builder image, WITHOUT dependency expansion; prefer `unit-java-web`.

unit-python.help: UNIT-PYTHON gate: the host-Python unit tests (pytest over the per-block test/unit roots, in its own venv).

unit-typescript.help: UNIT-TYPESCRIPT gate: build the React/TS production bundle then run the vitest frontend tests in Docker (#693/#860).
